checks.name: ck_ai_policy_configs_effective_period

checks.name: ck_ai_policy_configs_minimum_margin

checks.name: ck_articles_published_at

checks.name: ck_auth_challenges_purpose_channel
checks.expression: purpose = 'PASSWORD_RESET' OR (purpose = 'EMAIL_VERIFICATION' AND channel = 'EMAIL') OR (purpose = 'PHONE_VERIFICATION' AND channel = 'SMS')

checks.name: ck_order_items_price_override
checks.expression: NOT price_overridden OR (override_reason IS NOT NULL AND overridden_by IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_orders_customer_settlement
checks.expression: (customer_type = 'REGISTERED' AND farmer_profile_id IS NOT NULL) OR (customer_type = 'WALK_IN' AND farmer_profile_id IS NULL AND settlement_type = 'FULL_PAYMENT')

checks.name: ck_payment_allocations_single_target
checks.expression: (allocation_type = 'ORDER' AND order_id IS NOT NULL AND debt_entry_id IS NULL) OR (allocation_type = 'DEBT' AND debt_entry_id IS NOT NULL AND order_id IS NULL AND prepayment_consumed_amount = 0)

checks.name: ck_payments_order_context
checks.expression: (payment_context = 'ORDER_PAYMENT' AND order_id IS NOT NULL) OR (payment_context = 'DEBT_REPAYMENT' AND order_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_refunds_order_payment
